text: Welcome to the CogentSearch Q3 Financial and Strategic Review call.

segments.text: Good morning and welcome to the CogentSearch Q3 Strategic & Financial Review call.
segments.speaker: CEO

segments.text: In the third quarter, our Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) accelerated to $48.5 million, up 34% YoY.
segments.speaker: CEO

segments.text: Enterprise customer retention remained exceptional with a Net Dollar Retention (NDR) rate of 128%.
segments.speaker: CEO

segments.text: Turning to our infrastructure efficiency, gross margins improved to 82.4% with hybrid Qdrant retrieval.
segments.speaker: CFO

segments.text: Operating cash flow for the quarter was positive at $12.3 million with zero long-term debt.
segments.speaker: CFO

segments.text: For the full fiscal year 2026, we are raising revenue guidance to between $192 million and $198 million.
segments.speaker: CFO
